evidence.quote: dual polarisation in a 7.5 GHz wide band, divided in four spectral windows (1.875 GHz each), with 128 channels

method.value: Power-law fit to four flux densities; compare with radio and IR/optical extrapolations; Tb from radio-peak flux for emitting region smaller than a neutron star radius
